title: Python ML: Multiple Regression
description: Multiple regression is like linear regression, but with more than one independent value. It attempts to predict the value of a dependent variable based on several independent variables. In Python, the 'sklearn' library is the industry standard for implementing these models.
example:
# Multiple Regression with Pandas & Scikit-learn
import pandas
from sklearn import linear_model

df = pandas.read_csv("data.csv")
X = df[['Weight', 'Volume']] # Independent variables
y = df['CO2'] # Dependent variable

regr = linear_model.LinearRegression()
regr.fit(X, y)

# Predict CO2 emission for a car weighing 2300kg with volume 1300cm3
predictedCO2 = regr.predict([[2300, 1300]])
print(predictedCO2)
